description: A PostHog project secret API key (phs_...): a project-scoped key with a fixed set of API scopes, for server-side use. PostHog returns the key value only when the key is created; the handler writes it to an AWS Secrets Manager secret you provide and never puts it in the resource model.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the secret API key belongs to.

Id.description: The PostHog ID of the secret API key.

Label.description: Label that identifies the key in PostHog.

Scopes.description: Project-wide API scopes granted to the key, e.g. feature_flag:read or query:read. Project secret API keys do not honor object-level access controls, so a scope can access every resource of that type in the project.

SecretsManagerSecretArn.description: ARN of an existing AWS Secrets Manager secret. On create the handler writes the key value (phs_...) to it as the secret string, because PostHog returns the value only once. The resource type execution role needs secretsmanager:PutSecretValue on the secret (and kms:GenerateDataKey/kms:Encrypt when it uses a customer managed KMS key). Changing it replaces the key.

MaskValue.description: Masked form of the key value as shown in PostHog, e.g. phs_...abcd.
